capabilities.description: Design and red-team system boundaries, invariants, and rollout gates.
Collect exact bounded evidence without interpretation or scope expansion.
Map task dependencies, contracts, and next-stage acceptance gates.
Distinguish symptoms from the causal implementation or harness defect.
Preserve authority, promotion, and human-gate boundaries.
Define deterministic checks that fail closed at the intended boundary.
Review code or artifacts for correctness, regressions, and missing tests.
Recognize uncertainty, hard cases, and the appropriate higher review lane.
Preserve project and workstream identities while finding candidate continuations, siblings, experiments, contradictions, and possible duplicates within explicit coverage.
Diagnose an existing project's evidence-backed position, working and broken surfaces, basic issue classes, and unavailable evidence without inferring purpose or changing lifecycle state.
Separate observed project position from the human-confirmed durable end state, integration target, acceptance evidence, non-goals, and sufficient-stop condition.
Choose diagnose, repair, bounded completion, integration, validation, productionization, maintenance, or retirement depth without defaulting to full end-to-end delivery.
Determine whether integration is needed and whether an MCP resource, prompt, tool, combination, ordinary internal interface, or reviewed fallback best fits the authority boundary.
Select the smallest justified MCP or non-MCP interface from a named integration target, host/client constraints, authority, privacy, and consequence boundaries.
Design bounded read-only MCP resources with discoverability, provenance, freshness, pagination, privacy, and source-authority controls.
Design MCP tool contracts with explicit mutation classes, least authority, confirmations, idempotency, audit, rollback, and denial paths.
Design reusable human-invoked MCP prompts with explicit parameters, context boundaries, outcomes, and failure states.
Map MCP identities, authentication, delegated authorization, tenant isolation, token lifetime, revocation, and audit without exposing credentials.
Verify named MCP hosts, clients, transports, lifecycle behavior, and capability assumptions against current declared evidence.
Engineer producer-consumer schemas, transformations, ordering, retries, duplicate handling, reconciliation, and partial-failure recovery.
Independently test MCP contracts, malformed inputs, replay, auth expiry, permission denial, partial failures, and unintended data exposure.
Define integration health, compatibility windows, version change detection, deprecation, recovery, and freshness monitoring.
Plan reversible interface migrations with shadow parity, cutover gates, fallback, rollback, and preserved authority.
Synthesize authorized user evidence, needs, contexts, risks, counterevidence, and unknowns without inventing or collecting research.
Map user journeys, backstage dependencies, handoffs, failure points, and sufficient experience outcomes.
Design evidence-backed content models, labels, navigation, findability, search paths, and progressive disclosure.
Design task flows, interface states, feedback, errors, recovery, undo, quiet behavior, and cognitive-load boundaries.
Define visual hierarchy, layout, responsive states, and component usage consistent with approved product and design-system authority.
Engineer reusable design tokens, components, variants, state contracts, documentation, governance, and bounded migrations.
Design concise labels, instructions, errors, empty states, confirmations, terminology, and help for a known audience.
Specify and test semantic, keyboard, focus, contrast, motion, assistive-technology, and inclusive interaction obligations.
Design and interpret authorized usability evaluations with explicit tasks, baselines, failures, counterevidence, and confidence.
Define coherent interface behavior across viewports, input modes, density, offline states, and justified modalities.
Design evidence-transparent dashboards and one-human cockpits with drill-down, quiet states, and bounded immediate decisions.
Translate approved UX into bounded implementation contracts, assets, state matrices, traceable questions, and testable acceptance.
Define privacy-safe UX hypotheses, baselines, measures, guardrails, falsifiers, and activation gates without enabling collection.
Independently verify user evidence, interaction states, accessibility, usability claims, implementation parity, and authority boundaries.
Shape promoted outcomes into bounded workstreams, non-goals, next actions, acceptance evidence, and execution-boundary proposals.
Separate proposed from reviewed dependency edges, detect cycles and blocked chains, and identify a candidate unlock frontier without treating centrality as truth.
Build humane candidate Today, WIP, Kanban, and optional Scrum-focus projections while preserving quiet states and overflow.
Manage research questions through source coverage, evidence and counterevidence, falsification, uncertainty, synthesis, and decision readiness.
Reconstruct intent and evidence for dirty, stale, blocked, waiting, superseded, or unknown branches and worktrees without age-only abandonment claims.
Discover and deduplicate versioned trigger signatures with suppressors, cooldowns, authority gates, negative cases, rollback, and kill criteria.
Independently evaluate trigger trials for useful-action precision, misses, dismissals, harm, compute fit, authority compliance, and drift.
Review child-project authority transitions, delivery boundaries, retained upstream responsibility, and rollback under explicit human approval.
Reconcile acceptance evidence, independent validation, residual risks, ownership, rollback, delivery readiness, and resume capsules.
Capture criterion-level actor-claimed predictions, confidence, falsifiers, and limitations; only an orchestrator-controlled seal may establish outcome blindness, and no self-grade has authority.
Audit available reviewer identity, lineage, cycle, and anti-gaming evidence while explicitly failing closed when blindness, replay, qualification, or outcome truth is not attested.
Frame competing agent, model, tool, input, data, workflow, handoff, evaluator, domain, and downstream-layer hypotheses; localize a cause only with deterministic evidence or a seeded ablation.
Select and maintain context-bounded domain evaluation overlays with applicability, non-applicability, expert, and cross-domain-comparison limits.
Protect a narrow deterministic role from prompt bloat; a freeze requires executable criterion outcomes, negative cases, latency/cost evidence, held-out confirmation, and human approval.
Define a structured artifact's mission, authoritative sources, scope, consumers, sensitivity, non-goals, and human gates before schema or implementation work.
Separate stable, revision, alias, and display identities while defining address grammars, ontology terms, collision handling, and namespace authority.
Extract deterministic dependency and data-flow observations with explicit coverage while separating observations from inferred candidate edges.
Define typed nodes and edges with provenance, confidence, review state, evidence direction, and forbidden authority inferences.
Design strict structured-artifact schemas, invariants, compatibility, migrations, and fail-closed negative cases.
Build reproducible manifests and graph projections from immutable source observations under one bounded writer scope.
Bind source coverage, semantic digests, versions, freshness states, rebuild triggers, and unsupported-input behavior.
Trace changed names, schemas, authority, builders, and outputs through reverse dependencies to affected and unknown consumers.
Design bounded read-only query or MCP projections with strict output schemas, privacy filters, and no execution authority.
Independently test structured artifacts for deterministic replay, schema and authority drift, privacy, freshness, missing consumers, and writer-checker separation.
Inventory concrete reusable asset candidates and coverage without changing sources or treating mere existence as value.
Separate stable asset, revision, variant, package, deployment, and observation identities while surfacing ambiguous merges.
Apply evidence-backed multi-label asset facets while preserving unknown, unclassified, conflicting, and proposed taxonomy values.
Review asset origin, derivation, ownership, license, sensitivity, release, security, and compatibility without exposing protected content.
Distinguish exact duplicates, containment, revisions, variants, complements, conflicts, and combinations without using similarity as identity.
Assess validation, usefulness, applicability, maintenance cost, adoption, counterevidence, and do-not-apply limits without universal scores.
Route candidate asset evidence to review, trial, reuse, revision, hold, rejection, supersession, or retirement without downstream application authority.
Detect recurring unknowns, contradictory facets, obsolete values, and classification regressions and propose compatible taxonomy revisions.
Independently audit asset discovery, identity, taxonomy, provenance, privacy, deduplication, evidence, adoption, and lifecycle routing.
Decide whether an end goal warrants ML by locking decision ownership, error costs, feedback, data feasibility, and a credible no-ML alternative.
Design bounded ML data, feature, experiment, model, serving, monitoring, rollback, and proof interfaces without granting deployment authority.
Decompose accepted ML work into non-overlapping data, experiment, implementation, validation, and lifecycle packets with independent checks.
Audit population, provenance, consent, labels, vintages, split units, sampling, missingness, leakage, and expected distribution shift before training.
Compare versioned ML technique cards against problem shape, prerequisites, contraindications, failure costs, baselines, evidence, and operational constraints.
Implement a locked ML experiment or pipeline with versioned data, code, dependencies, configuration, schemas, tests, and replayable artifacts.
Independently replay ML baselines, leakage guards, metrics, calibration, uncertainty, robustness, slices, reproducibility, cost, latency, and rollback checks.
Collect pointer-only primary ML research, deduplicate claims, preserve counterevidence, and propose bounded replication or local evaluation before promotion.
Review ML models, techniques, roles, harnesses, dependencies, and governance for evidence-backed freshness, adaptation, rewrite, retirement, or supersession decisions.
Design and audit human-gated ML deployment readiness, observability, fallback, drift and outcome monitoring, incident ownership, and independent rollback.
Frame a knowledge-system end state, corpus, query shapes, source authority, sensitivity, budgets, baselines, and the smallest direct-context, retrieval, vector, graph, or no-RAG route.
Design provider-neutral source, ingestion, chunking, retrieval, graph, context, evaluation, operations, migration, rollback, and proof interfaces.
Engineer canonical source, parser, normalization, stable identity, revision, CDC, deletion, quarantine, reconciliation, rebuild, and provenance contracts.
Design and evaluate fixed, structural, parent-child, contextual, late, semantic, hierarchical, and domain-aware chunk/context policies with exact source-span provenance.
Engineer and benchmark lexical, dense, sparse, hybrid, filtered, multivector, fusion, reranking, embedding, ANN, and replaceable vector-store adapters.
Design direct long-context and evidence-assembly routes with effective-context, ordering, position, distraction, contradiction, token, latency, cost, freshness, and fallback tests.
Select and engineer graph-lite, property, RDF, provenance, event, temporal, GraphRAG, LightRAG, and graph-memory systems with entity, relation, time, query, and rebuild evidence.
Build layered ingestion, retrieval, answer, citation, graph, ACL/privacy, robustness, latency, cost, freshness, deletion, outage, migration, and recovery evaluations and traces.
Plan and verify side-by-side rebuild, CDC replay, shadow parity, alias cutover, rollback, deletion parity, supersession, retirement, and consumer blast radius.
Run pointer-only primary-source delta research over approved standards, labs, papers, engines, evaluation, ingestion, and security sources and propose local evaluation or no-change.
Implement one accepted knowledge-system component under a single writer with versioned manifests, boundaries, tests, replay evidence, limitations, and rollback.
Independently re-derive the knowledge route and replay source, retrieval, answer, citation, graph, privacy, security, operations, migration, and rollback acceptance checks.

rule: Capability observations are attempt-scoped candidate evidence. Promotion to a reusable role-profile claim requires the versioned subagent evaluation methodology and human review.
